subject.statement: Vijay Mallya was the owner of Kingfisher Airlines.

summary: Verdict: TRUE – Vijay Mallya was the owner of Kingfisher Airlines (99% confidence). Decisive facts: Kingfisher Airlines was established in 2003; Vijay Mallya served as Chairman from January 2004 onward; he held a 1.87% shareholding and was listed as a promoter; multiple sources describe him as chairman and promoter, indicating ownership and control.

findings.statement: Vijay Mallya's full legal name is Vijay Vittal Mallya and he is commonly known as Vijay Mallya.
Vijay Mallya held a 1.87% shareholding in Kingfisher Airlines and was listed as a promoter.
Vijay Mallya served as Chairman of Kingfisher Airlines from January 2004 onward.
